meta.purpose: P0 contract & skeleton phase: exhaustively inventory every top-level OMP_DATA field consumed by the ver1 app so contracts can be built before any page is migrated. Inventory only; no page migration, no Host availability assumed.

sensitivityEnums.public-safe: safe for a public read model / bootstrap
sensitivityEnums.contains-path: carries filesystem, home, or local-endpoint path-like data; must be redacted or served via private endpoint
sensitivityEnums.contains-pid: carries process identifiers (pid or pid-embedding text)
sensitivityEnums.contains-secret-risk: carries bridge tokens, credentials, or secret-adjacent data
sensitivityEnums.ui-only: presentation-local data; safe to derive or keep renderer-side

sourceCategories.client-bootstrap: delivered in ClientBootstrap (public authority/runtime identity, manifest summary, opaque selected IDs, surface capabilities only)
sourceCategories.renderer-ui: derived client-side in the renderer from other read models
sourceCategories.deferred-p1plus: post-P0 capability (FRONTEND_INTEGRATION.md 12.2/12.5); no P0 channel commitment

meta.mutationLifecycle: local_pending -> accepted -> optional interaction_required -> terminal completed|failed|rejected|outcome_unknown (applies to future mutations; none of these fields is a mutation)

coverage.note: Every top-level D.<field> assignment in mock-data.js is represented exactly once below. No field is shared between bootstrap and a read model; risky path/pid data is marked for redaction, never placed in a public read model.

pageChecklist.notes: Project cards must drop p.path from the public model (redact; ResourceHandle on demand). Runtime flags (running/attention/preview) should ride project.list subscription once available. After migration the page must not read OMP_DATA (section 12.1).

No direct OMP_DATA reads: initEnv uses a hardcoded check table that duplicates diagnostics values (ompPath, version, rpc, configDir). Data source must become Runtime resolver/installer/self-check surfaced via client-bootstrap (public authority/runtime identity + surface capabilities only). The duplicated path values are exactly what bootstrap must exclude.
Time Travel rail is a hardcoded local array (no OMP_DATA dependency). Session list -> sessionCatalog.list exposing opaque IDs and safe summaries only.
Manifest-driven: skills/plugins/mcp/hostTools/slashCommands map to capability manifest read models. skills[].path and plugins[].src carry home-relative paths -> opaque ids, never raw paths.

Section 12.1 explicitly requires copyable, redacted (已脱敏) diagnostics. Public model carries version/rpc/capabilities/error summaries only; ompPath/cwd/configDir/processes[].pid/bridge-pid go through PrivateEndpoint.

pageChecklist.migrationPhase: P5 deferred (config persistence is section 12.5 last-batch)
pageChecklist.notes: initSettings is self-contained UI with no OMP_DATA reads. Future dependency: config persistence channel (deferred-p1plus).

Core workbench slice: transcript snapshot + cursor subscription for events; telemetry subscription; changes/diff/problems/tests as workspace read models; minimap derived renderer-side. Agents panel is P4 (hub.registry); preview/terminals are P5 (section 12.5) and carry the redaction rules above (pid/cwd/url/path/session query).

hub.registry snapshot + hub.event subscription; transcripts as separate heavy query. sessionFile/outputPath/patchPath must render as opaque artifact refs (agent://<id>), never raw file names; runtime.pid excluded from public model.
Reads window.OMP_MR (models-data.js), not OMP_DATA. No P0 dependency; model registry should eventually come from a query, but P0 does not invent Host availability for it.
